# MathJax

MathJax 3.2.2, `es5/tex-svg.js`, distributed under the Apache 2.0 license included here.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

The existing TeX → SVG renderer is bundled locally so the initial page and consulted formulas do not require a third-party CDN. No rendering-library migration is included in this change.
